summary: The PR addresses the issue of preserving certain assumptions during posify but introduces some assumptions that might not always be appropriate.

issues.description: The patch preserves multiple assumptions (finite, integer, rational, prime, even, odd) which might not always be appropriate. For example, a symbol could be finite but not necessarily an integer, rational, prime, even, or odd. This could lead to incorrect simplifications in some cases.
The new assumptions are added in a single line without any comments explaining why these specific assumptions are being preserved. Adding a comment would improve readability and maintainability.
